reason: Genuine port. One missing-header check per doc: a `select_when` content regex `\A(?:#![^\n]*\n)?(?<AFTER>)` anchors at offset 0, or at the start of the line after a shebang (capture.AFTER), and fires when the `program` has no qualifying first comment; an empty file is a program without one, so it needs no separate check. The trailing-newline check is a content regex anchored at \A; the header regex is a rule option, ported through overrides. Every failure is zero-width.

evidence.why: TSLint reports at 2:1 (offset after `#!...\n`); the empty AFTER group starts there, while `program` starts at 1:1

audit.note: Port genuine for a given header regex, but that regex is TSLint's mandatory `match` option; the default doc bakes the fixtures' `Good header \d`, so it flags every real file. The first comment after an optional shebang must match the header regex, which is TSLint's required `match` option (each doc carries the fixture's); an empty file and a shebang file report where TSLint does (zero-width, after the shebang line). allow-single-line-comments and the trailing-newline option are overrides.

requiresConfiguration: the header regex is mandatory (fileHeaderRule.ts:52, minLength 1 at :94); the port's default doc bakes the fixtures' `Good header \d` and flags every file
